drivers.history: Leclerc won the GP3 and Formula 2 championships before entering Formula 1 with Sauber in 2018. The Monaco-born driver now races for Ferrari.
Hamilton began his Formula 1 career in 2007 and has raced for McLaren, Mercedes and Ferrari. His seven world titles accompany career records for Grand Prix wins and pole positions.
Russell won the 2017 GP3 and 2018 Formula 2 titles. After racing for Williams, he took his first Grand Prix victory with Mercedes in 2022.
Antonelli won the Italian and ADAC Formula 4 championships in 2022, then both the Middle East and European Formula Regional titles in 2023. Mercedes guided his progression from karting to Formula 1.
Verstappen entered Formula 1 with Toro Rosso at 17. His first race for Red Bull, in Barcelona in 2016, brought his first Grand Prix victory.
Hadjar progressed through French Formula 4, Formula Regional and the Formula 3 ladder before joining the Formula 1 grid in 2025. He now races for Red Bull Racing.
Norris made his Formula 1 debut with McLaren in 2019. He won the 2025 drivers’ championship and continues with the team alongside Oscar Piastri.
Piastri grew up in Melbourne near Albert Park before moving to Europe to develop his racing career. He now represents McLaren alongside Lando Norris.
Alonso is a two-time world champion. His career has continued into a long-running partnership with Aston Martin, where he races alongside Lance Stroll.
Stroll entered Formula 1 with Williams in 2017 and reached the podium in Baku during his rookie season. He now races for Aston Martin.
Gasly made his Formula 1 debut in Malaysia in 2017. He raced for Toro Rosso and Red Bull before the later stages of his career brought him to Alpine.
Colapinto joined the Williams driver academy in 2023 and replaced Logan Sargeant on the Formula 1 grid during 2024. He later moved to Alpine.
Bearman made his Formula 1 race debut for Ferrari at the 2024 Saudi Arabian Grand Prix, replacing Carlos Sainz. He now races for Haas alongside Esteban Ocon.
Ocon won the European Formula 3 championship in 2014 and the GP3 title in 2015. He made his Formula 1 debut with Manor during the 2016 season.
Lindblad is the only rookie on the 2026 grid. His path through the Red Bull junior programme included race victories in Formula 3 and Formula 2.
Lawson made his Formula 1 debut at the 2023 Dutch Grand Prix when Daniel Ricciardo was injured. He is listed alongside Arvid Lindblad in Racing Bulls’ current official line-up.
Sainz entered Formula 1 with Toro Rosso in 2015, alongside Max Verstappen. The Madrid-born driver now races for Williams.
Albon was born in London and races under the Thai flag. He entered Formula 1 with Toro Rosso in 2019 and earned a promotion to Red Bull during the same season.
Hülkenberg began his Formula 1 career with Williams in 2010 and took pole position in Brazil during that rookie season. He now races for Audi.
Bortoleto is a Formula 2 champion from São Paulo. After building his career in European single-seater racing, he joined Formula 1 and now races for Audi.
Perez’s Formula 1 career has included Sauber, McLaren, Force India, Racing Point and Red Bull. He now races for Cadillac alongside Valtteri Bottas.
Bottas made his Formula 1 debut with Williams in 2013. His career has included a spell at Mercedes, and he now races for Cadillac.
Tsunoda was born in Sagamihara and made his Formula 1 debut in 2021. In 2026 he has served as Red Bull’s test and reserve driver and returned to Racing Bulls for the Dutch Grand Prix.
